canonical_name: Riemann mapping theorem (classical planar theorem family)
literal_source_claim_zh: 单连通区域共形等价于单位圆盘
literal_source_claim_en: A simply connected domain is conformally equivalent to the unit disk.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies no source edition or definition chain and omits proposition-changing conditions. The statement phase must determine whether domain supplies nonemptiness, openness, and connectedness; explicitly exclude the whole complex plane; fix the planar ambient space and simple-connectedness convention; define global biholomorphic equivalence; and decide whether normalized uniqueness is included. Freezing a familiar textbook form at intake would invent these missing decisions.
domain_and_universes: Prospective domain: a source-selected proper nonempty open simply connected subset U of mathlib Complex, its subtype topology, the open complex unit disk, maps between the corresponding subtypes, and Prop in universe 0. Exact explicit versus definition-carried assumptions remain open.
conclusion: Prospective conclusion: existence of a source-faithful conformal equivalence between U and the open unit disk. Exact forward/inverse analyticity, bijection, normalization, and uniqueness clauses remain open.

alternate_encodings.target: For every nonempty simply connected proper open U in Complex, there exists a biholomorphic equivalence between the subtype U and Complex.UnitDisc.
alternate_encodings.relationship: standard candidate formulation, not selected or credited

alternate_encodings.target: For every eligible U and base point z0 in U, there is a unique biholomorphism to the unit disk sending z0 to zero with positive real derivative.
alternate_encodings.relationship: normalized stronger candidate whose existence and uniqueness clauses are not present in the catalog gloss

alternate_encodings.target: Every simply connected Riemann surface is biholomorphic to the sphere, plane, or disk.
alternate_encodings.relationship: general uniformization theorem, not the selected planar root without checked specialization

excluded_degenerate_cases: Not frozen. The statement phase must resolve the empty set, non-open or singleton sets, the whole complex plane, the unit disk itself, unbounded proper domains, boundary points, orientation-reversing conformal maps, and whether base-point normalization and uniqueness are part of the claim.
candidate_scope_not_credited: existence of a biholomorphic equivalence for every proper nonempty simply connected planar domain
the normalized existence-and-uniqueness form after choosing a base point
an ambient-map formulation with exact MapsTo and inverse laws
a subtype homeomorphism with analytic forward and inverse maps
excluded_substitutions: the uniformization theorem for arbitrary simply connected Riemann surfaces
a bounded-domain-only or Jordan-domain-only special case
Schwarz lemma, open mapping, local inverse, or local conformality alone
a topological homeomorphism without holomorphic forward and inverse maps
Caratheodory boundary extension, prime ends, boundary regularity, or explicit formulas
a structure or hypothesis that assumes the desired equivalence
the untrusted verified label or adjacent API checks as proof credit

formal_candidate_discovery_not_credited.reported_shape: For an open connected proper subset U of Complex with has_primitives U, there exists a complex-differentiable injective ambient function whose image of U is Metric.ball 0 1.
formal_candidate_discovery_not_credited.status: third-party intake discovery only; revision retrieval, source and target match, proof-body provenance, placeholders, axioms, trust, license, toolchain compatibility, and repo-local integration are all unaudited

computation_profile: No numerical conformal-map approximation, mesh, boundary sampler, floating-point computation, oracle, or unchecked certificate is credited; the expected theorem is analytic and noncomputable
